correctness.rationale: From u=x²+y², du/dt=alpha z u/2 and angular rate -Omega. Set k=a^4-1, X=k/u-a², Y=sqrt(k)z/u; exact Lie derivatives give Xdot=-sigma Y, Ydot=sigma X with sigma=alpha sqrt(k)/2, and a global analytic inverse on X>-a². A harmonic circle remains in the half-plane for rho<a² and leaves it otherwise, giving the precise two-sided lifespan as allowed arc length divided by |sigma|. Tangency at rho=a² yields r~tau^-1; transverse exit for rho>a² yields r~tau^-1/2, while the z leading coefficient is 4/alpha or 2/alpha, respectively. Axis Riccati has lifespan pi/|sigma|. Independent SymPy recomputed both Lie identities, angular speed and rho²=1+kH. Full completeness is not inferred from finite tests.
